# Procedure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Procedure`](gmeow-Procedure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Procedure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

A prescriptive specification — a template, recipe, protocol, blueprint, workflow definition, or pipeline spec. The plan side of the plan ⟂ execution de-conflation: an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) that describes how to do something, distinct from any [`Execution`](gmeow-Execution.md) that enacts it. The kind of procedure is a [`gmeow:procedureType`](../properties/gmeow-procedureType.md) value, never a subclass.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Procedure`](gmeow-Procedure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
